title: Global solvability of the heat equations in two unbounded domains and the interface
summary: This paper considers the existence of a unique global-in-time strong solution to the heat equations in two unbounded domains $Ω_A$, $Ω_B$ and the interface $Γ(= \partial Ω_A \cap \partial Ω_B)$. We introduce and study some function spaces in the two unbounded domains and the interface. We apply our function spaces and maximal $L^p$-regularity for Hilbert space-valued functions to show the existence of a local-in-time strong solution to our heat equations.
